Come home and get some{br}proper rest.{page}Then you'll have your strength{br}back...{close}

entries.en: Revenge is perilous, my boy.{br}Gransista founded the Buster{br}Association to end the Dark{page}Century.{page}Visit an Appraisal Hut often for{br}news and requests. Complete and{br}report them: a retinal appraisal{page}earns you the bounty and promotion{br}points.{close}
